name: Barbell Split Squat
steps: Stand in a staggered stance with the bar across your upper back and your rear heel raised.
Bend both knees to lower the rear knee toward the floor.
Drive through the front foot to rise without moving either foot.
Switch sides after finishing this side.
tips: Space your feet hip-width apart side to side to keep your hips level and balanced.
Track your front knee straight over your toes without letting it collapse inward.
